Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    vector<vector<int>> insert(vector<vector<int>> &intervals, vector<int> &newInterval) {
        vector<pair<int, int>> q;
        for (auto interval : intervals)
        {
            q.push_back({interval[0], 1});
            q.push_back({interval[1], -1});
        }
        q.push_back({newInterval[0], 1});
        q.push_back({newInterval[1], -1});

        auto cmp = [](const pair<int, int>& a, const pair<int, int>& b)
        {
            if (a.first == b.first)
                return a.second > b.second;
            else return a.first < b.first;
        };

        sort(q.begin(), q.end(), cmp);
        int count = 0;
        int start, end;
        vector<vector<int>> results;
        for (auto x : q)
        {
            count += x.second;
            if (x.second == 1 && count == 1)
            {
                start = x.first;
            }
            else if (x.second == -1 && count == 0)
            {
                end = x.first;
                results.push_back({start, end});
            }
        }
        return results;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<vector<int>> intervals = {{1,3},{6,9}};
    vector<int> newInterval = {2,5};
    auto res = sol.insert(intervals, newInterval); /* 加断点到下一行进行debug, 可以看到结果 */    
    return 0;
}
